scope: 25 final candidate-map videos; identity, frame/state and visual-content evidence binding
approvalBoundary: This report approves the listed final candidate files for the visual gate only. Audio and runtime integration remain separate gates.

methodology.finalCandidateReview: Every final path was reviewed across the full 15 seconds as a 15-frame 1 fps contact sheet. A3B also received a 30-frame 2 fps identity-segment review against the locked eight-person identity sheet.
methodology.reencodeReview: All 22 final paths whose video passed through runtime/audio finalization were compared with the visually approved source using FFmpeg SSIM plus source/output frames at 0.5, 7.5 and 14.5 seconds. SSIM All range: 0.980699 to 1.000000; no visible identity, composition, text, logo, state or causality change was observed.
